entries.title: Ask HN: Successful one-person online businesses?
entries.author: gajus
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Successful one-person online businesses?
entries.excerpt: This question was asked 2 years ago ( https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=13326535 ) by mdoliwa, and I'm curious what it looks nowadays. > How many people on hacker news are running successful online businesses on their own? What is your business and how did you get started? > Defining successful as a profitable business which provides the majority of the owners income.
entries.guide_zh: HN 用户分享由一人经营、能提供主要收入的成功在线生意。

entries.title: Ask HN: What's a promising area to work on?
entries.author: richtapestry
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What's a promising area to work on?
entries.excerpt: What's an area that people think is up and coming? (e.g. like social networks were in 2004, mobile apps in 2010, or vlogging in 2014) I've finished several projects simultaneously and I'm looking to work in an area with lots of users, but as yet few producers. Wouldn't even need to involve programming, but probably would need to be online, as I'm pretty introverted!
entries.guide_zh: HN 用户讨论哪些领域正在兴起，值得投入新的项目。

entries.title: Ask HN: Are there books for mathematics like Feynman's lectures on physics?
entries.author: pirate_is_back
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Are there books for mathematics like Feynman's lectures on physics?
entries.excerpt: I have started re-learning college level Physics and am thoroughly enjoying Feynman's Lecture on Physics. Are there similar books available for Mathematics (& Chemistry) - books that are fundamental and easy to read?
entries.guide_zh: 喜欢费曼物理学讲义，数学领域有没有同样深入浅出的经典教材？

entries.title: Ask HN: How do you share/organize knowledge at work and life?
entries.author: gavribirnbaum
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How do you share/organize knowledge at work and life?
entries.excerpt: I find it hard right now to share knowledge with everyone on the team and to turn knowledge into actual learnings. I don't know how you guys do it, but I would love to know. We are now 50 people in the company and I don't know anymore how to make this scale. What is your process? Do you use any tool for it? How good is it? What needs improving?
entries.guide_zh: 团队知识如何整理、共享并真正转化为学习，也聊个人生活中的做法。

entries.title: Ask HN: How was life for a regular dev during the dot com burst?
entries.author: kace91
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How was life for a regular dev during the dot com burst?
entries.excerpt: I'm a youngish developer (28y/o), and the constant recent comments of people predicting a new burst have made me curious about how life changed for developers at the time, and maybe what to expect if such a thing were to happen again. I've heard stories of rich startup founders losing everything back then, but not much about what happened with the average devs. What was it like, living through those times? Did many people change careers? was there still a thriving industry in
entries.guide_zh: 互联网泡沫破裂时，普通开发者的就业与生活发生了哪些变化？

entries.title: Ask HN: Feasible Alternative to the MacBook Pro?
entries.author: ryanmccullagh
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Feasible Alternative to the MacBook Pro?
entries.excerpt: The MBP is by far the best laptop I’ve used. The graphics are amazing, and the touchpad is ergonomic. However, Apple has demonstrated their inability to be reliable. I bought my MBP in January of this year (2019) and tomorrow I’ll pick it up from its 3rd repair. I’ve grown tired of this repair routine. And after the 3 years runs out, they will start charging me.
entries.guide_zh: 习惯了 MacBook Pro 的屏幕与触控板，还有哪些笔记本能作为替代？

entries.title: Ask HN: What do you self-host?
entries.author: aeleos
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What do you self-host?
entries.excerpt: I know this is has been posted before but that was a few years ago so I wanted to restart the discussion, as I love hearing about what people host at home. I am currently running an Unraid server with some docker containers, here are a few of them: Plex, Radarr, Sonarr, Ombi, NZBGet, Bitwarden, Storj, Hyrda, Nextcloud, NginxProxyManager, Unifi, Pihole, OpenVPN, InfluxDB, Grafana.
entries.guide_zh: 你在家里或自己的服务器上托管哪些服务，又为何选择自己维护？

entries.current_title: Ask HN: What is the most beautiful piece of code you've ever read?

entries.title: Ask HN: What are the most fundamental books on computer science?
entries.author: michalu
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What are the most fundamental books on computer science?
entries.excerpt: I'm relatively new to CS (4 years) and I've seen a lot of great book recommendations here. But every discipline has it's most fundamental books ... e.g. philosophy -> Socrates, Plato, Aristotle, civil law -> code civil, christianity -> bible, etc. one should read to get a truly deep understanding. What are those books for CS?
entries.guide_zh: 初入计算机科学领域，哪些著作称得上构建学科根基的必读书？
